notes: Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood for vector search + embeddings pipeline. Team intent: pilot on Hosted API for dev + staging, move to Dedicated (VPC) for production if throughput/cost targets met.
Key stakeholders: Head of Product (Asha Patel), Infra Lead (Liam O'Connell), Data Platform Manager (Rina Kaur). AE: Maya T., SE: Javier C.
Workload details: primary workload = semantic search for in-app help + cross-doc retrieval; secondary = nightly batch embedding jobs for 1.2M docs; occasional reranking for top-K results.
Performance targets: query 95th pct latency < 150ms for search (99th < 300ms preferred), sustained qps target 80-120 for peak, batch upserts 150k-250k vectors/day during nightly windows.

Vector DB integration: currently using Pinecone for index layer in prod. POC will test both direct Redwood embeddings -> Pinecone flow and Redwood Dedicated hosting of index-friendly vectors (considering moving to Weaviate later). Need examples for connector/ETL pattern.

Throughput/scale questions raised on call: how Redwood handles concurrent embed requests + batching, prefix caching effectiveness for short queries, autoscaling behavior on Dedicated pools during nightly batch jobs.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required; must support SSO (SAML/Okta). KMS integration for key-by-customer encryption, audit logs for token-level events, and a 90-day retention policy on logs. Data residency discussion: prefer NA-only host for production (customer legal request).
Cost sensitivity: product team focused on unit cost per 1k tokens and per-vector embedding. Finance flagged Dedicated commit vs burst cost model — needs example scenarios from Redwood pricing deck.

POC scope agreed: (1) proof-of-concept on Hosted API for 2-week integration, measure latency/cost on representative query set; (2) run nightly batch embed job against a 50k document sample to validate upsert throughput; (3) demo Dedicated config with VPC preview and autoscaling policy options.
Timeline: POC kickoff targeted 2026-03-15, results review 2026-03-29, procurement decision by 2026-05 (if metrics met). AE/SE to present Dedicated pricing options to finance week of 2026-04-12.
